Along Hudkeshwar Road by two-wheeler, car or auto, since there is no metro in this part of the city. Tutors from Manewada or the Pipla Road side, both close by, have the shortest trip and can find homes from landmarks on the main road.
What housing is most common in Hudkeshwar?

Mostly two- and three-bedroom apartments, followed by independent houses and plots along the main road and behind it. Newer apartment buildings generally register visitors, so inform the gate in advance; independent homes are simpler, with space for the tutor to park outside.
When should a tutor from central Nagpur visit Hudkeshwar?

Outside office hours. Traffic on Hudkeshwar Road and towards Manewada is heavier then, so plan evening classes with a margin. The main road has a growing mix of shops and services, which can slow the final stretch at busy times.
